facts.fact: 蹲守：Taesia 立于每日变姿的机关巨像顶瞄 Aphelion——杀 Varrick（第二阶段入侵总管、少一个 general/vessel）；vertigo 示警——西边细光柱：Phos 在用王座；Nyx 逼令「Act, now, or I will act for you」。
facts.anchor: What the fuck do you know of sacrifice?

facts.fact: 尸变战开：Varrick 挡身锁剑喝问「why do you desecrate your own child's body」——Phos 扭腕碎骨把他摔飞；Risha 咳出小黄花落地即枯。
facts.anchor: “BECAUSE IT IS NOT TRULY DEAD SO LONG AS I INHABIT IT,”

facts.fact: 无琴有怒：第三眼开缝 scream——火海之潮吞没 Kaspan 尸——Phos 在火中笑（a vision of ash and contempt）。
facts.anchor: Angelica didn’t have her violin. But she had her anger.

facts.fact: 神的诛心：火中低语「HOW LONG WILL YOU STAY TETHERED TO YOUR EARTHLY MAGIC?...LITTLE SPAWN?」——「WHEN WILL YOU REALIZE THAT THIS IS WHAT SHE WANTS?」——Deia 的 mortal sovereign 诱言回灌，她惊恐自燃。
facts.anchor: THAT THIS IS WHAT SHE WANTS?

facts.fact: 反杀：Risha 拔尸臂之骨掷贯其脊、Cosima 长刀刺入未毁之羽——尸发亡者尖啸、火噬圣羽——「YOU WILL NOT ESCAPE THIS REALM WITH YOUR LIVES.」
烧伤自愈：Risha 右肩 grisly 烧痕——数息间愈合如初（Godsnight Gala 上 Angelica 曾失控伤过她）——「What… happened?」
Varrick 觉悟：「Those feathers—he always meant to use you, just like he used Rian」——羽已毁其一，下一个附体容器就是他（bracer 下微光）——「I am—Lord Phos’s to command」的信仰裂缝。
facts.anchor: he always meant to use you,

facts.fact: 章末现身：skybridge 玻璃爆碎——Taesia 自阴影立起、懒转剑锋——「Have you ever stopped to consider he might be, oh, I don’t know… fucking using you?」——Angelica 第一次看见她如今的样子。
